page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 64 physical cores, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration with no hyperthreading. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz.

The instance features 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached volumes. There are no integrated GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated physical core allocation provides predictable compute performance by eliminating hyperthreading resource sharing, which supports qualitative cost efficiency for compute-intensive tasks. However, the lack of local storage and GPU hardware limits its suitability for high-speed local data processing or machine learning workloads. This configuration is appropriate for general-purpose enterprise applications, database hosting, and multi-threaded workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources.
